condition.name: wrist_camera_dropout_partial_observation
condition.description: Zero the wrist-camera RGB observation before frozen X-VLA action generation while leaving simulator state, rewards, success criteria, proprioception, and agentview RGB unchanged.
condition.physical_meaning: A wrist-mounted camera can be occluded, disconnected, saturated, or otherwise unavailable during manipulation; the condition tests partial-observation robustness rather than natural reset residual mining.
condition.future_matched_protocol: The same input-side wrist RGB dropout must be applied to Prior and Prior + Ours.

target.instruction: pick up the black bowl on the ramekin and place it on the plate
target.clean_baseline_source: bounded OCR trace pass, unperturbed frozen X-VLA, both identities successful

verification_protocol.pass_condition: Condition verified if both preregistered baseline identities complete without infrastructure failure and wrist-dropout success is at least one episode lower than the 2/2 clean baseline.

next_action: Run exactly the two-episode frozen-prior wrist-dropout verification, then select one method only if the condition is verified.
